title: Social Security Act — Statute profile
subject: Social Security Act
summary: Social Security Act is a statute of United States enacted in 1935, in the area of social welfare. Created the Social Security system of old-age and unemployment insurance. It is formally cited as 49 Stat. 620.
key_points: Core effect: Created the Social Security system of old-age and unemployment insurance.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
